meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 充当 oh-my-opencode 的发布经理:触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流、轮询等待其跑完、校验 npm 包与 GitHub release,撰写发布说明并发布到 Discord。
howto.when: 当你提到 “publish”、“release”、“deploy” 等关键词,并给出 patch、minor、major 或明确语义版本号时触发;未给发布选项它会先停下来问。

say.note: 触发 patch 版发布工作流

say.text: release minor,发布说明里带上迁移注意
say.note: 发 minor 版并撰写发布说明

say.text: 用 5.0.0-beta.9 这个版本号发布

howto.what_en: Installs Claude as release manager for oh-my-opencode: it triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, waits for it to finish, verifies the npm packages and GitHub release, drafts release notes and posts to Discord.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'publish', 'release' or 'deploy' and give a selector: patch, minor, major, or an explicit semantic version; it stops to ask if none is given.

say_en.text: release minor and include migration notes
say_en.note: Ships a minor release with notes
